about: What the character select and HUD show in each skill slot. Mario's moves come from SM64 itself; these rows only describe them. iconTile is the tile of Mario's own texture (from the ROM) drawn on the icon. Tiles: 0 metal, 1 button, 2 M logo, 3 sideburn, 4 mustache, 5-8 eyes, 9-10 wings.

rows.name: Super Mario 64
rows.description: Mario moves exactly as in Super Mario 64: triple jumps, long jumps, backflips, wall kicks, side flips and ground pounds.

rows.name: Punch, Punch, Kick
rows.description: Press B for a three-hit combo. Run and press B to dive, or press B in the air for a jump kick. Each hit deals <style=cIsDamage>240%-300% damage</style>.

rows.name: Ground Pound
rows.description: Press Z in the air to ground pound, dealing <style=cIsDamage>600% damage</style> around where you land. Z while running slides into a <style=cIsDamage>350%</style> slide kick.

rows.name: Crouch
rows.description: Also Z. Crouch then jump for a long jump (running) or a backflip (standing).

rows.name: Stomp
rows.description: Land on an enemy's head to deal <style=cIsDamage>400% damage</style> and bounce off it.
